summary: Enforceability of liability-exclusion clause (GCC 49.5) in construction contract; exclusion of damage claims for employer delay; extension of time as sole remedy; consistent judicial upholding of such clauses; irreversible election by contractor to accept time extension without claiming damages; public policy and patent illegality not established; additional documents not considered; impugned judgment upholding arbitral award affirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 s.16, s.34, s.37
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment of Delhi High Court upheld; arbitral award sustaining clause 49.5 affirmed.
